title: Towards Fully Automated Medical Imaging Code Generation via Validation-based Context Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2608.29016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable promise in program generation for small-scale and conventional application development; however, they remain limited when applied to complex, domain-specific tasks such as medical image processing. General-purpose models lack explicit domain knowledge and robust validation mechanisms to ensure correctness, often requiring substantial human intervention to produce reliable processing pipelines. To address these limitations, we propose AutoMedImg, a multi-agent framework for fully automated medical image processing code generation. AutoMedImg orchestrates specialised agents across two phases: a Planning Phase that performs dataset analysis and architecture design with semantic and formal verification, and a Coding Phase that generates modules in parallel with static checking, execution testing, and assembly validation. translated_title: 基于验证式上下文工程的全自动医学影像代码生成
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在小规模和常规应用开发的程序生成方面已展现出巨大前景；然而，当应用于医学图像处理等复杂的、特定领域的任务时，它们仍然存在局限。通用模型缺乏明确的领域知识和稳健的验证机制来确保正确性，通常需要大量的人工干预才能生成可靠的处理流水线。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 AutoMedImg，一个用于全自动医学图像处理代码生成的多智能体框架。AutoMedImg 在两个阶段中协调专门的智能体：规划阶段执行数据集分析和架构设计，并进行语义验证和形式化验证；编码阶段并行生成模块，并进行静态检查、执行测试和组装验证。这种多阶段验证机制可以缓解错误传播……
tldr: 提出了AutoMedImg，一个通过规划与编码两阶段多智能体协作及多级验证机制，实现医学影像处理代码全自动生成的框架。
en_tdlr: AutoMedImg, a multi-agent framework with planning and coding phases combined with multi-stage validation, enables fully automated code generation for medical image processing.
